meta.title: Leonida Platinum Guide — GTA VI trophies (PS5)
meta.note: Names, descriptions and grades checked against the live PlayStation trophy list as mirrored by Exophase, and cross-checked against five independent full lists (18 Nov 2026). Rockstar, Sony and Microsoft have not published a list through their own channels. The guide text is written in our own words. Five hidden trophies still have no confirmed unlock method at launch, and their guides say so. Gamerscore values are left out: the published Xbox numbers disagree with each other.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This one unlocks on its own once the other 54 are done — there is nothing extra to do for it. The long road is A Long Road, the 100% Gold. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then the side strands, then the free-roam grinds, and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter since there is no mission replay.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Work through the 100% checklist — a reported 35 tasks, found after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. Anything you did before the credits still counts. Most of the checklist is other trophies: 300 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles discovered, all 8 bank vaults and all 39 Illegal Operations. Save it for last, after the credits, when the whole map is open.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Stunt jumps, flying under bridges, knife flights, base jumps — anything the game counts as a stunt adds to the total. The counter runs the whole game, so watch it in Progress. You need 250 here and 300 for 100%, so keep going past 250.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Take a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 golds across the two ranges, as reported. This is a skill check, not a grind: learn each range's pattern first, then run them back to back once your aim is warm.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Vaults open through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is, near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and slip into the vault while the guard has it open. Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the bags alone. Rob 5 vaults and get away each time; every vault gives you a 4-star Wanted Level right away, so escaping with your partner also earns Hot Together.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight stranger mission strands across Leonida. Some optional questlines do not count — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's each have their own trophy — so check the progress counter after every strand you finish. The Chapter 3 Race Against Yago is time-sensitive: it carries an hourglass icon, so do it as soon as it appears and save beforehand.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Finish 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; pick them up as you explore instead of hunting them all at the end. Your collection screen shows which sets still need cards.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations with the WAiNK app. Scan whatever you pass — landmarks, shops, signs — and the count grows by itself. Vehicles you scan with WAiNK also count as discovered for Whip It Good.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once, as reported. The activities list sits in your Progress menu — work through it early so you know what exists, and the trophy pops as soon as the ninth type is tried.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race twenty times. Mix street races, drone races and every other race type; your wins are tracked per event.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Stand next to your partner, shake a 4-star Wanted Level and escape the heat. A bank vault job (Maximum Withdrawal) is the easiest way to get 4 stars at once. Break line of sight, get out of the red heat zone and wait for the stars to clear — it pops once you are fully clear, not while you are still hiding.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Bring your partner along and rob three shops in a row without losing your Wanted Level. If the stars fade and only the red heat zone remains, the chain breaks — stay hot between shops and move quickly. It can take around 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Find 100 vehicles. A WAiNK scan counts as a discovery, so scan the traffic as you drive. 100% asks for 200 of the 277 base models, as reported, so keep scanning long after this one pops.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: See all of Leonida, every region on the map. Drive the roads and visit each area until the map is filled in. It goes hand in hand with the WAiNK scans and the vehicle-discovery grind.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Hit one Illegal Operation for each of the 9 gangs, as reported. Operations show on the map once found; 100% wants all 39, so this one pops along the way. Bring heavy weapons — the sites are guarded.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from bank jobs and payday loan jobs; sell them on to your contacts and the total builds up across the whole game.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Take a Top Fun Drone Race win at each of the 14 locations, as reported. One win per location is enough; learn a course's turns before you chase the win.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops, cumulatively — weapons, clothes, food, anything counts. It fills up on its own if you buy gear as you go; check Stats if you are close.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight garages from the Vice City Real Estate app, which opens after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost roughly $160,000, as reported. Garages handed to you by the story do not count — only ones you buy.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Put 10 vehicles on the Scooter Bros app. It opens in the Chapter 2 mission Moses: take a stolen car to Moses, pick Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Every car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Out-fish Cal in a fishing challenge. The challenges show up as you play the fishing activity; win the head-to-head against Cal and the trophy is yours.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game all the way through — any machine, any game. The arcades are in Vice City; sit down, play it to the end, and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 counts toward this and disappears after that chapter. Do it in Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida, as reported. Spots show as purple icons when you get close. Reported: an outdoor spot counts twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner each time. CAN MISS: the balcony meditation with Lucia in Chapter 1 counts and is gone after that chapter. Once Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning — she walks out to the balcony of Jason's house to meditate. Follow her and take the optional task.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus — the slow-motion aim (L3 + R3 while aiming). Find a group of gang enemies, such as the guards at an Illegal Operation, and use an assault rifle. Build Adrenaline first, since it stretches Focus out.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without anyone noticing. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs hands you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry robberies. Use the Snap Gun on the shop's locked back door — kicking it in trips the alarm. In the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe and slip out unseen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. If you are spotted, reload instead of pushing on.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Hold up an Armored Truck and get away. The trucks run set routes — ambush one, take the cash and shake the heat. It fits nicely with the Chapter 4 bank-vault jobs, so try it while you are already set up for robberies.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish 50 Challenges, listed under Progress > Challenges — 80 in total, as reported. Plenty complete on their own as you play; 100% wants 70, so keep going past 50.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. Unmissable — it pops while you play the story.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Unmissable. Chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter instead of on the last cutscene, as reported, so do not worry if it runs a few minutes late.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Unmissable — it pops as Chapter 3 opens, after Welcome to Vice City. Note: PlayStation lists this name in the censored form shown here; Press-Start prints it uncensored, and that uncensored form matches the Chapter 3 title reported by GameSpot and others. Checked again at build time (19 Nov 2026): the live Exophase list shows the description only, so the censored PSN form is used, as the competition's official list requires.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Unmissable.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Unmissable.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. Unmissable — but keep an untouched manual save from just before it: there is no mission replay, and you will want that save for cleanup.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Breakfast Run (Chapter 2). Unmissable story trophy.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist (Chapter 3, its final mission). Unmissable story trophy.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play. Unmissable story trophy.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Headliners. Unmissable story trophy.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown. Unmissable story trophy.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable story trophy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's final mission. Side-story finales stay open after the credits, so there is no rush — wrap up Kenton's strand when you are ready.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's final mission. A side-story finale; still open after the credits. Note: Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's final mission. A side-story finale; still open after the credits. Reported: Andy's questline is Lucia-only. Note: Andy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's final mission. A side-story finale; still open after the credits.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's final mission. A side-story finale; still open after the credits. Reported: Tyrone's questline is Jason-only. Note: Tyrone's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only, as reported, and sends you after animals through target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine. The finale stays open after the credits.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave VCIA on a flight nobody scheduled. Steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — gates E3 and E4 work, as reported; planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Reach the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. It pops late: fly about 1 km clear of the airport first. Save beforehand — the police arrive fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Climb into a military tank — 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos'. Tanks are reported parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, climb in, and drive and fire until it pops.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — Kingpin Bowling, an Illegal Operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs. Grab all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and what is inside the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then lose the police. Leave something behind and the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Reported: it pops when Jason and Lucia both hit maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner — they train alongside you.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. Reported: it counts 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up on its own — just play.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. METHOD NOT YET CONFIRMED at launch — the description is the only hint. The most likely reading is a particular bar or viewpoint on Ocean Beach; try the beachfront bars and viewpoints. This guide will update the method once it is confirmed — do not trust any method that is not confirmed.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. METHOD NOT YET CONFIRMED at launch — the description is the only hint. It most likely means driving a car through a showroom's glass front; which showroom is not confirmed. Do not trust unconfirmed methods.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. METHOD NOT YET CONFIRMED at launch — the description is the only hint. The wording points to retrying something that failed once; what exactly is not confirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? METHOD NOT YET CONFIRMED at launch — the description is the only hint. Most likely it marks some strange or paranormal event out in Leonida; what sets it off is not confirmed.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. METHOD NOT YET CONFIRMED at launch — the description is the only hint. A melee drive-by at a bowling alley (Kingpin Bowling) is the likely reading, but that is a deduction from the description, not a confirmed method.
